name: Pagination
description:
The Pagination component lets users navigate between the pages of a data set.

Use the default `<Pagination>` to render the previous and next triggers around one button per page (with ellipses), or pass `compact` to show "page of total" text between the triggers instead. Non-part children render inside the root, where `usePaginationContext()` reads the state, e.g. to `slice()` your data. Compose `Pagination.ItemList`, `Pagination.CompactList`, `Pagination.PrevTriggerWithIcon`, `Pagination.NextTriggerWithIcon`, `Pagination.ItemButton` and `Pagination.EllipsisButton` for custom layouts, or the unstyled primitives for full structural control: every part accepts Panda style props, `css` and `asChild`.

parts.name: El
parts.description: An abstraction that renders the previous and next triggers around the page items and ellipses, or "page of total" text with `compact`

props.name: page
props.description: The controlled active page.

props.name: compact
props.description: Display a compact layout of only text information and triggers.

props.name: layout
props.description: The layout of the button group.

parts.name: ItemList
parts.description: An abstraction that renders a Group of the previous trigger, one button per page or ellipsis, and the next trigger

parts.name: CompactList
parts.description: An abstraction that renders a Group of the previous trigger, "page of total" text, and the next trigger

parts.name: PrevTriggerWithIcon
parts.description: An abstraction of the previous trigger rendered as a square IconButton with the Cerberus `calendarPrev` icon

props.name: layout
props.description: The layout of the Group the trigger renders in. `attached` renders an `outlined-subtle` IconButton so it matches the attached items.

parts.name: NextTriggerWithIcon
parts.description: An abstraction of the next trigger rendered as a square IconButton with the Cerberus `calendarNext` icon

props.name: layout
props.description: The layout of the Group the trigger renders in. `attached` renders an `outlined-subtle` IconButton so it matches the attached items.

parts.name: ItemButton
parts.description: An abstraction of the item rendered as an outlined-subtle Button that shows its page number

parts.name: EllipsisButton
parts.description: An abstraction of the ellipsis rendered as an outlined-subtle Button that shows "…"

parts.name: Root
parts.description: The root container of the Pagination component.

props.name: id
props.description: The unique identifier of the machine.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the accordion. Useful for composition.

props.name: translations
props.description: Specifies the localized strings that identifies the accessibility elements and their states

props.name: count
props.description: Total number of data items

props.name: pageSize
props.description: The controlled number of data items per page

props.name: defaultPageSize
props.description: The initial number of data items per page when rendered. Use when you don't need to control the page size of the pagination.

props.name: siblingCount
props.description: Number of pages to show beside active page

props.name: boundaryCount
props.description: Number of pages to show at the beginning and end

props.name: page
props.description: The controlled active page

props.name: defaultPage
props.description: The initial active page when rendered. Use when you don't need to control the active page of the pagination.

props.name: onPageChange
props.description: Called when the page number is changed

props.name: onPageSizeChange
props.description: Called when the page size is changed

props.name: type
props.description: The type of the trigger element

props.name: getPageUrl
props.description: Function to generate href attributes for pagination links. Only used when `type` is set to "link".

props.name: asChild
props.description: Merges props and accessibility attributes onto the immediate child element instead of rendering a wrapper DOM node.

props.name: css
props.description: PandaCSS style object for custom atomic styling. All PandaCSS style props (e.g. p, bg, color) are also accepted.
